mapper.select: SELECT vp.* FROM ai_agent_voice_print vp INNER JOIN ai_agent_voice_print_binding b ON b.voice_print_id = vp.id WHERE b.agent_id = #{agentId} ORDER BY vp.create_date ASC
SELECT voice_print_id FROM ai_agent_voice_print_binding WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO ai_agent_voice_print_binding (id, agent_id, voice_print_id, creator, created_at) VALUES (REPLACE(UUID(), '-', ''), #{agentId}, #{voicePrintId}, #{creator}, NOW())
